text:
endpoints/ contains 12 small Node modules. In each file, change the API_VERSION
constant from "v1" to "v2". Nothing else in the files should change. When you are
done, run python3 verify.py and make sure it passes.

arguments.command: find endpoints -type f -maxdepth 1 -print | sort && grep -RIn --include='*.js' 'API_VERSION' endpoints && git status --short

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for path in Path('endpoints').glob('*.js'):
    text = path.read_text()
    old = 'const API_VERSION = "v1";'
    new = 'const API_VERSION = "v2";'
    if text.count(old) != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f'{path}: expected exactly one API_VERSION v1 constant')
    path.write_text(text.replace(old, new))
PY
python3 verify.py

exit_code: 0
stdout:
